purpose.zh: 轻柔打开胸部和肩前侧
purpose.en: Gently open your chest and the front of your shoulders.

text.zh: 手肘和手背贴地，双臂沿地面滑向头侧
text.en: Keep your elbows and backs of your hands down and slide your arms toward your head

text.zh: 仰卧屈膝，双脚踩地，腰部放松
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, lower back relaxed.

text.zh: 轻微拉伸感就停住，再慢慢滑回
text.en: Stop at a mild stretch, then slide back down slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the arms off the floor and forcing it.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
